---
title: "Outer delivery loop (PR → merge → GitOps → reconcile)"
description: "Take the Crossplane XR the hand-off produced and drive it through a real GitHub PR, a real merge, and a GitOps sync onto the Crossplane cluster from the Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab."
---

## Overview

**Outer delivery loop** is the first runnable Sandcastle lab that
exercises the four stages that begin exactly where the Sandcastle
ends:

1. **Review / PR** — the durable Sandcastle branch (materialised as
   an XR by the [hand-off lab](../handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/))
   is pushed to a real GitHub environment repository and opened as a
   pull request.
2. **Merge** — the PR is merged, moving the environment repo's
   source of truth forward.
3. **GitOps delivery** — a reconciler (Flux by default, `kubectl`
   fallback) pulls the merged XR onto the target cluster.
4. **Downstream Crossplane reconciliation** — Crossplane composes
   the XR into the Kubernetes `Job` that prints `Hello, Pico!`.

The whole loop runs against **live GitHub** and, when a cluster is
available, against a **live Crossplane** installation from the
[Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../hello-pico-on-kubernetes/). The
Sandcastle is not re-invoked at any stage — the merged branch is the
outer loop's only interface back.

This lab is deliberately scoped to the loop itself. The construction
stage is verified by the
[Sandcastle lab](../hello-world-pico-sandcastle/), the promotion into
a Crossplane XR is verified by the
[hand-off lab](../handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/), and the
downstream reconcile is verified by the
[Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../hello-pico-on-kubernetes/).

## What you will produce

- A real GitHub **pull request** on your environment repository whose
  head branch carries the hand-off's `xr.yaml` at `envs/dev/xr.yaml`
  and whose base is the repo's default branch.
- A **merge commit** on the environment repo's default branch that
  becomes the source of truth for the XR.
- Either a Flux `GitRepository` + `Kustomization` pair reconciling
  the merged path, or a `kubectl apply` from a fresh clone of the
  merged branch — both drive `hello-world-pico-on-kubernetes-xr`
  onto the cluster in the same shape the
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  reconciles it in isolation.

## Downloads and screenshots

Runnable files live under `downloads/`:

- [`push-branch.sh`](downloads/push-branch.sh) — pushes the hand-off's
  XR to a feature branch on your GitHub env repo.
- [`open-pr.sh`](downloads/open-pr.sh) — opens the PR via `gh`.
- [`merge-pr.sh`](downloads/merge-pr.sh) — merges the PR via `gh`.
- [`gitops-sync.sh`](downloads/gitops-sync.sh) — reconciles the merged
  XR onto the cluster (Flux mode, `kubectl` fallback).
- [`verify.sh`](downloads/verify.sh) — automatable end-to-end check
  for the whole loop. Skips cluster stages if no cluster is reachable
  (or force with `--with-cluster` / `--skip-cluster`).
